uaf-llm02.summary: All five candidates are false positives. In every case the "free" is either dead code (#if 0), immediately followed by a NULL assignment, or immediately followed by a reassignment of the same pointer; the "reads" are either of a different struct/field or occur before the free. No real free→use path exists.

verdicts.reason: The only frees of header.section_info are inside `#if 0` dead code (decode.c:3797-3808), so they never execute. The listed reads (dwg_decode:152-227) touch header.version/from_version/num_sections — different fields, and no section_info free precedes them. No live free→use path.

bit_chain_free frees dat->chain then immediately sets dat->chain = NULL (bits.c:3032-3033). dat_read_stream frees dat->chain then sets it NULL and returns (dwg.c:173-175). enforce_null_termination overwrites dat->chain with a fresh malloc'd copy (llvmfuzz.c:56-59) — a leak, not a UAF. All frees are followed by nulling/reassignment before any further use.

dxf_free_pair frees pair->value.s then sets it NULL (in_dxf.c:512-513) and frees the pair itself (515). In dxf_classes_read the read of pair->value.s (1484) happens BEFORE dxf_free_pair(pair) (1487), and pair is then reassigned via dxf_read_pair (1488). Read precedes free; no use-after-free.

Every free of obj->dxfname is immediately followed by reassignment: encode_unknown_as_dummy 1296→1297 and 1339→1340; json_OBJECTS 2767→2769 and 2814→2815. The read at dwg_encode:2221 is klass->dxfname (a Dwg_Class, different struct). dwg_encode_get_class:3357 aliases obj->dxfname = klass->dxfname but performs no free. No free→use path.

All three frees are immediately followed by reassignment: encode_unknown_as_dummy 1289→1290 and 1332→1333; dxf_header_read 1084→1085 (o->name = bit_utf8_to_TU(...)). The read at dwg_encode:2852 is info->name (a Dwg_Section_Info, different struct). dwg_fixup_BLOCKS_entities:6168 reads _obj->name with no preceding free of that pointer. No free→use path.

uaf-llm03.summary:
All five candidates are false positives. In every case the "release" site either (a) is inside `#if 0` dead code, (b) is immediately followed by a NULL assignment or a fresh reassignment of the same pointer, or (c) the "read" site is a different object/field than the one freed. No candidate has a demonstrable call path where a free precedes a use of the same still-reachable pointer.

- Candidate 1 (->header): the only frees of `dwg->header.section_info` / `[u].sections` are at decode.c:3803/3805, inside an `#if 0` block (3797–3808). Dead code, never compiled. The 319 "reads" are ordinary header field accesses in other functions.
- Candidate 2 (->chain): both free sites null the pointer immediately — bits.c:3032-3033 (`free(dat->chain); dat->chain = NULL;`) and dwg.c:173-174 (`free(dat->chain); dat->chain = NULL; return ...`). The `enforce_null_termination` "write" (examples/llvmfuzz.c:59) overwrites `dat->chain` with a fresh malloc'd copy, and the later `bit_chain_free(&dat)` frees that copy and nulls it. encode.c:3168 frees `file_dat.chain` while line 3170-3171 reads `dat->chain` (a different Bit_Chain). No UAF.
- Candidate 3 (->value): `dxf_free_pair` (in_dxf.c:512-513) frees `pair->value.s` and immediately sets it to NULL, then frees `pair` itself. Every caller either returns right after, or re-reads a fresh pair via `dxf_read_pair` (e.g. 12307-12308, 625-626, 160-173). The sample read at 12303 is on a freshly read pair. No path reads a freed `value.s`.
- Candidate 4 (->dxfname): all four frees are immediately followed by reassignment — encode.c:1296-1297/1339-1340 (`free(obj->dxfname); obj->dxfname = strdup(...)`), in_json.c:2767-2769 and 2814-2815. free.c:873 uses `FREE_IF` which is defined (free.c:58-63) to `free(ptr); ptr = NULL;`. The sample "read" at dwg_find_class:536 is a comment line. No dangling read.
- Candidate 5 (->name): encode.c:1289-1290/1332-1333 free then immediately reassign. in_dxf.c:1084-1086 frees `o->name` then immediately assigns `bit_utf8_to_TU(...)` (which returns NULL only on OOM, so the field becomes NULL, not dangling). The sample read at encode.c:2852 is `info->name`, a fixed-size char array inside `Dwg_Section` — a different object than the freed `Dwg_Object.name`. decode.c:6168 reads `_obj->name` (BLOCK_HEADER's own name field), not the freed `Dwg_Object.name`.

verdicts.reason: The only frees of dwg->header.section_info and section_info[u].sections are at decode.c:3803 and 3805, which sit inside an `#if 0` ... `#endif` block spanning lines 3797-3808 (confirmed by grep of #if 0/#endif in decode.c). This code is never compiled, so no release ever happens. The 319 'reads' are ordinary header field accesses (e.g. dwg_decode:152-153, decode_R2004:3775-3790) that operate on a live header. No release→use path exists.

Both free sites null the pointer immediately. bits.c:3032-3033 does `free (dat->chain); dat->chain = NULL;`. dwg.c:173-174 does `free (dat->chain); dat->chain = NULL; return DWG_ERR_IOERROR;` — control leaves the function right after. The 'write' at examples/llvmfuzz.c:59 (`dat->chain = copy`) replaces the pointer with a fresh malloc'd copy, and the subsequent `bit_chain_free(&dat)` (llvmfuzz.c:104/119/132) frees that copy and nulls it. In encode.c:3168 `bit_chain_free(&file_dat)` frees file_dat.chain, while the following reads at 3170-3171 touch `dat->chain` (a different Bit_Chain, orig_dat). No path reads a freed chain.

dxf_free_pair (in_dxf.c:512-513) frees pair->value.s and immediately sets pair->value.s = NULL, then frees pair itself (515). Every caller either returns immediately after the free (e.g. 588-589, 1013-1019) or re-reads a brand-new pair via dxf_read_pair before touching value again (e.g. 12307-12308, 625-626, 160-173). The sample read at 12303 (`while (pair && pair->code == 0 && pair->value.s)`) operates on a pair freshly returned by dxf_read_pair at 12308/12312. No path reads a freed value.s.

All four free sites are immediately followed by reassignment of the same pointer: encode.c:1296-1297 and 1339-1340 (`free (obj->dxfname); obj->dxfname = strdup (...)`), in_json.c:2767-2769 and 2814-2815 (`free (obj->dxfname); obj->dxfname = strdup (dxfname)`). free.c:873 uses FREE_IF, which is defined at free.c:58-63 as `if (ptr) free (ptr); ptr = NULL;` — so it nulls the pointer. The sample 'read' at dwg_find_class:536 is a comment line, not an access. No dangling read of dxfname exists.

encode.c:1289-1290 and 1332-1333 free obj->name then immediately reassign it (strdup or a string literal). in_dxf.c:1084-1086 frees o->name then immediately assigns bit_utf8_to_TU(...), which returns NULL only on OOM (bits.c:2577-2581) — so the field becomes NULL, never dangling. The sample read at encode.c:2852 (`strcpy (info->name, name)`) targets info->name, a fixed-size char array inside Dwg_Section, a different object than the freed Dwg_Object.name. decode.c:6168 reads _obj->name (BLOCK_HEADER's own name field), again not the freed Dwg_Object.name. No release→use path on the same pointer.

uaf-llm04.summary: 全部 5 个候选均判为 false_positive。每个候选的"释放"点要么位于 #if 0 死代码中，要么在释放后立即置空/重新赋值，要么释放与读取属于不同生命周期（每次循环迭代重新获取对象），不存在一条真实调用路径让释放先发生、读取后发生。

verdicts.reason: 唯一的释放点 decode_R2004:3803/3805 位于 #if 0 ... #endif 死代码块内（decode.c:3797-3808），编译后根本不存在。样例读取 dwg_free:1243 与 decode_R2004 的释放不在同一生命周期，且释放代码从不执行。无真实释放→读取路径。

两个释放点都在释放后立即置空并返回错误：bit_chain_free:3032-3033 free 后 dat->chain=NULL；dat_read_stream:173-174 free 后 dat->chain=NULL 并 return DWG_ERR_IOERROR。调用方 dwg_read_file:240-242、dwg_read_dxf:12645-12647 在 error>=DWG_ERR_CRITICAL 时直接 return，不再访问 chain。符合规则 2/3，无 UAF。

唯一释放点 dxf_free_pair:512 free(pair->value.s) 后立即 pair->value.s=NULL（513），随后 free(pair) 销毁整个 pair。所有读取点（如 dxf_thumbnail_read:12334）都在同一循环迭代内、在 dxf_free_pair(pair) 之前读取，之后 pair 被重新赋值为 dxf_read_pair(dat) 的新对象。释放与读取属于不同生命周期（不同 pair 实例），符合规则 1/2，无 UAF。

所有释放点后都立即重新赋值：encode_unknown_as_dummy:1296-1297 free 后 strdup("POINT")，1339-1340 free 后 strdup(dxfname)；json_OBJECTS:2767-2769 free 后 json_string 赋值，2814-2815 free 后 strdup(dxfname)。符合规则 2（释放后重新赋值），无 UAF。
释放点后均立即重新赋值：encode_unknown_as_dummy:1289-1290 free 后 strdup("POINT")，1332-1333 free 后 strdup(name)；dxf_header_read:1084-1086 free(o->name) 后立即 o->name = bit_utf8_to_TU(...)。符合规则 2，无 UAF。

uaf-llm05.summary: Analyzed all 5 candidates. Only candidate 3 (->value) is a real UAF: in dxf_objects_read, the else-branch calls dxf_free_pair(pair) at line 12284 without reassigning pair, and the inner while-loop back-edge re-reads pair->code / pair->value.s on the freed pointer. Candidates 1 and 2 are false positives (free is dead code / free is followed by NULL). Candidates 4 and 5 are false positives (every free is immediately followed by reassignment).

verdicts.reason: The only frees of dwg->header.section_info / section_info[u].sections are at decode.c:3803 and 3805, both inside an `#if 0` block (lines 3797-3808). This is dead code that is never compiled, so no free ever executes. The 319 'reads' are ordinary header field accesses in decode/dwg_bmp/dwg_decode etc. No live free→read path exists.

bit_chain_free (bits.c:3032) frees dat->chain then immediately sets dat->chain = NULL (3033), so subsequent dat->chain[...] reads are NULL derefs, not UAF. dat_read_stream (dwg.c:173) likewise frees then sets dat->chain = NULL (174) before returning. In encode.c:759-761, dat1 = *hdl_dat is a shallow copy; bit_chain_free(&dat1) frees the shared chain but only NULLs the local dat1 copy, and hdl_dat is overwritten at 761 (*hdl_dat = *dat) before any dereference — no read of the freed chain occurs. enforce_null_termination (llvmfuzz.c:59) overwrites dat->chain with a fresh malloc copy; the later bit_chain_free frees that copy and NULLs it. No free→read path.

In dxf_objects_read (in_dxf.c), the inner loop `while (pair != NULL && pair->code == 0 && pair->value.s)` at 12267. In the else branch (not is_dwg_object), line 12284 calls dxf_free_pair(pair) which frees pair->value.s and then frees pair itself (dxf_free_pair at 512/515). dxf_free_pair takes the pointer by value, so its `pair = NULL` at 516 only nulls the local copy — the caller's `pair` remains dangling. The else branch does NOT reassign pair, so the loop back-edge (12286 → 12267) re-evaluates `pair->code` and `pair->value.s` on the freed Dxf_Pair. This is a genuine use-after-free read. (The is_dwg_object branch at 12275-12276 is safe because pair is reassigned by new_object.)

All four frees are immediately followed by reassignment. encode_unknown_as_dummy:1296 free(obj->dxfname) then 1297 obj->dxfname = strdup("POINT"); 1339 free then 1340 strdup(dxfname). json_OBJECTS:2767 free(obj->dxfname) then 2769 obj->dxfname = json_string(...); 2814 free then 2815 strdup(dxfname). No read of the freed pointer occurs between free and reassignment. The reads at 1259/1325/2770/2810/2812 all happen before the corresponding free or after reassignment.

All three frees are immediately followed by reassignment. encode_unknown_as_dummy:1289 free(obj->name) then 1290 obj->name = strdup("POINT"); 1332 free then 1333 strdup(name). dxf_header_read:1084 free(o->name) then 1085-1086 o->name = bit_utf8_to_TU(...). No read of the freed pointer between free and reassignment. The reads at 1259/1325/6168/6197/2984/2985 occur before the free or after reassignment.
